| [`cacheHeaders`](#ssr-static-cacheheaders) | Cache policy for production serving. |

#### `cacheHeaders`

```ts
const cacheHeaders: { readonly immutable: { readonly 'cache-control': "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"; }; readonly revalidate: { readonly 'cache-control': "public, max-age=0, must-revalidate"; }; readonly dynamic: { ...; }; }
```

Cache policy for production serving.

### Types and interfaces

| Name | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`ClientAssets`](#ssr-static-clientassets) | What a server-rendered page loads: the client entry and the modules to preload with it. |
| [`FetchApp`](#ssr-static-fetchapp) | Anything with a fetch handler: a Hono app, or a plain function. |
| [`ManifestChunk`](#ssr-static-manifestchunk) | One chunk of Vite's `.vite/manifest.json` (the fields serving uses). |
| [`PrerenderedPage`](#ssr-static-prerenderedpage) |  |
| [`PrerenderOptions`](#ssr-static-prerenderoptions) |  |
| [`ProductionOptions`](#ssr-static-productionoptions) |  |
| [`RenderMode`](#ssr-static-rendermode) | How a route is rendered. |
| [`ViteManifest`](#ssr-static-vitemanifest) | Vite's build manifest (`build.manifest: true`): chunks by source path or chunk key. |

#### `ClientAssets`

```ts
interface ClientAssets {
    /** The entry chunk's URL, for `page({ scripts })`. */
    readonly entry: string;
    /**
     * Chunks the entry is known to need, for `page({ modulepreload })`: its static imports and
     * Gyral's lazily loaded hydration chunk with its imports. Without the hints the browser
     * finds them only after it has fetched and parsed the entry (a server-rendered page would
     * fetch the hydration chunk a round trip later still).
     */
    readonly modulepreload: readonly string[];
}
```

What a server-rendered page loads: the client entry and the modules to preload with it.

#### `FetchApp`

```ts
interface FetchApp {
    readonly fetch: (request: Request) => Response | Promise<Response>;
}
```

Anything with a fetch handler: a Hono app, or a plain function.

#### `ManifestChunk`

```ts
interface ManifestChunk {
    readonly file: string;
    readonly imports?: readonly string[];
    readonly dynamicImports?: readonly string[];
    readonly css?: readonly string[];
}
```

One chunk of Vite's `.vite/manifest.json` (the fields serving uses).

#### `PrerenderedPage`

```ts
interface PrerenderedPage {
    readonly path: string;
    readonly file: string;
    readonly status: number;
}
```


#### `PrerenderOptions`

```ts
interface PrerenderOptions {
    readonly app: FetchApp;
    /** URL paths to render, e.g. every `ssg` route of the route table. */
    readonly paths: readonly string[];
    /** Directory the HTML files go to (`/about` → `<outDir>/about/index.html`). */
    readonly outDir: string;
    /** Origin used for the requests (absolute URLs in canonical links etc.). */
    readonly origin?: string;
}
```


#### `ProductionOptions`

```ts
interface ProductionOptions {
    /** Build output: `client/` (Vite, with `.vite/manifest.json`) and `static/` (prerendered). */
    readonly distDir: string;
    /** The client entry as named in the Vite manifest. Default `src/entry-client.ts`. */
    readonly entry?: string;
    /**
     * Builds the request-time renderer (the same app the prerender step used). Pass
     * `modulepreload` on to `renderPage({ modulepreload })` so pages preload what the entry needs.
     */
    readonly createApp: (options: {
        readonly clientEntry: string;
        readonly modulepreload: readonly string[];
    }) => FetchApp;
}
```


#### `RenderMode`

```ts
type RenderMode = 'ssg' | 'ssr' | 'csr';
```

How a route is rendered.

#### `ViteManifest`

```ts
type ViteManifest = Readonly<Record<string, ManifestChunk>>;
```

Vite's build manifest (`build.manifest: true`): chunks by source path or chunk key.

#### `commandsFor`

```ts
function commandsFor<I, M>(commands: ReadonlyArray<Command<M>>, driver: Driver<I, unknown> | Named): ReadonlyArray<Command<M> & {
    readonly input: I;
}>;
```

The commands addressed to `driver` (matched by name, so fakes and real drivers agree).

#### `customElementsIn`

```ts
function customElementsIn(root: ParentNode): Element[];
```

Custom elements under `root`, including those inside (nested) shadow roots.

#### `fakeDriver`

```ts
function fakeDriver<I = unknown, O = unknown, E = unknown>(of: string | Driver<I, O, E>, options?: FakeOptions<I, O, E>): FakeDriver<I, O, E>;
```

A recording driver for DOM-level tests: `el.drivers = { http: fakeDriver(http) }`.
Pass a real driver to copy its name and concurrency, or just a name. Failures pass
through unchanged unless you give `toError`, so `rejectNext(error)` takes the typed error.

#### `hydrated`

```ts
function hydrated(page: MountedSsr | ParentNode, options?: HydratedOptions): Promise<void>;
```

Waits until the page's Gyral components have rendered (docs/design-docs/view/04-scheduler.md
"`settled()`"): releases lazy islands if asked, then `await settled()`. Islands still
deferred are left alone. It throws when a server-rendered custom element never upgraded
(import its module, or list it in `allowUndefined`). Given a `MountedSsr`, it also throws
when console errors/warnings or uncaught errors were recorded since mounting.

#### `initial`

```ts
function initial<S, M extends Tagged, P>(spec: ComponentSpec<S, M, P>, props?: P): Stepped<S, M>;
```

Runs `init` without a DOM. `props` defaults to `{}`.

#### `inputsFor`

```ts
function inputsFor<I, M>(commands: ReadonlyArray<Command<M>>, driver: Driver<I, unknown> | Named): readonly I[];
```

The inputs of the commands addressed to `driver`.

#### `mountSsr`

```ts
function mountSsr(html: string, options?: MountSsrOptions): MountedSsr;
```

Mounts server output: a full document (head + body) or a body fragment. Call it before
importing component modules so elements upgrade and hydrate like on a real page load.
- Only `<head>` styles are applied: `<style>` inside Declarative Shadow DOM belongs to its
  shadow root and must not leak into the page.
- The store seed and named `<meta>`s are restored, as the browser would see them.

#### `readerOf`

```ts
function readerOf(stores: readonly AnyStoreInstance[]): StoreReader;
```

`ctx.read` over the given store instances (ADR 0013); unknown stores fail loudly.

#### `reject`

```ts
function reject<M>(command: Command<M>, error: unknown): M | undefined;
```

The message a command produces if its driver fails with `error` (already typed, i.e.
after the driver's `toError`). `undefined` when the command has no `onFailure`.

#### `resolve`

```ts
function resolve<M>(command: Command<M>, output: unknown): M | undefined;
```

The message a command produces if its driver succeeds with `output`.

#### `run`

```ts
function run<S, M extends Tagged, P>(spec: ComponentSpec<S, M, P>, messages: ReadonlyArray<NoInfer<StepMessage<M, P>>>, options?: NoInfer<RunOptions<S, P>>): Ran<S, M>;
```

Folds messages through `update`, collecting every command (including `init`'s).

#### `sentTo`

```ts
function sentTo<S, M extends Tagged>(commands: ReadonlyArray<Command<unknown>>, store: Store<S, M>): M[];
```

The messages a reducer's commands `send()` to `store`, in order.

#### `step`

```ts
function step<S, M extends Tagged, P>(spec: ComponentSpec<S, M, P>, state: NoInfer<S>, msg: NoInfer<StepMessage<M, P>>, props?: NoInfer<P>, stores?: readonly AnyStoreInstance[]): Stepped<S, M>;
```

Feeds one message through `update` without a DOM. Framework messages (`PropsChanged`,
`IntentRejected`, `StoreChanged`, `Hydrated`) without a reducer leave state unchanged, as in
the element. `stores` are the instances `ctx.read()` sees.

#### `stepStore`

```ts
function stepStore<S, M extends Tagged>(store: Store<S, M>, state: NoInfer<S>, msg: NoInfer<M>): Stepped<S, M>;
```

Feeds one message through a store's `update` without an instance.

#### `testStore`

```ts
function testStore<S, M extends Tagged>(store: Store<S, M>, initial?: NoInfer<S>): StoreInstance<S, M>;
```

A fresh store instance for one test, optionally starting from `initial`. Give it to an
element (`el.stores = { [store.name]: instance }`) or to `step(…, [instance])`.

#### `undefinedElementsIn`

```ts
function undefinedElementsIn(root: ParentNode, allow?: readonly string[]): readonly string[];
```

Server-rendered custom elements that never upgraded (gyral-czi.32): their module wasn't
imported, so nothing hydrated them and a test could pass without exercising them.

#### `virtualTime`

```ts
function virtualTime(): VirtualTime;
```

Replaces timers and `Date` with a virtual clock (ADR 0006, "Testing"). It patches the
platform rather than Gyral's runtime, so it covers drivers, debounces and retry delays
alike and does not depend on how the interpreter is implemented. Microtasks stay real,
so promises and the runtime keep working.

#### `withDrivers`

```ts
function withDrivers(root: Element, drivers: DriverOverrides): () => void;
```

Substitutes drivers for every Gyral component under `root` (including nested components in
shadow roots), e.g. a test container or `mountSsr(...).root`. Returns a function that removes
the overrides. Per-element `el.drivers` still wins (Gyral ADR 0006, tree-scoped drivers).

### Types and interfaces

| Name | Summary |

#### `FakeCall`

```ts
interface FakeCall<I, O> {
    readonly input: I;
    readonly signal: AbortSignal;
    /** Settles this call (only for fakes without `impl`). */
    readonly resolve: (output: O) => void;
    readonly reject: (error: unknown) => void;
    /** Streams a value into this call (DriverContext.emit); ignored once settled or aborted. */
    readonly emit: (output: O) => void;
    readonly settled: boolean;
}
```

One recorded `run` of a fake driver.

#### `FakeDriver`

```ts
interface FakeDriver<I, O, E> extends Driver<I, O, E> {
    readonly calls: ReadonlyArray<FakeCall<I, O>>;
    /** Inputs of every call so far. */
    readonly inputs: readonly I[];
    /** Settles the oldest unsettled, non-aborted call. Throws if there is none. */
    resolveNext(output: O): void;
    rejectNext(error: unknown): void;
    /** Streams a value into the newest call that is still running. Throws if there is none. */
    emitNext(output: O): void;
}
```


#### `FakeOptions`

```ts
interface FakeOptions<I, O, E> {
    /** Answer calls immediately. Without it, calls wait for `resolveNext`/`rejectNext`. */
    readonly impl?: (input: I, ctx: DriverContext<O>) => O | Promise<O>;
    readonly concurrency?: Concurrency;
    readonly retry?: RetryPolicy;
    readonly toError?: (cause: unknown) => E;
}
```


#### `HydratedOptions`

```ts
interface HydratedOptions {
    /**
     * Custom element tags allowed to stay undefined (never upgraded). `gyral-stores` is always
     * allowed: in the browser it is a plain scoping element.
     */
    readonly allowUndefined?: readonly string[];
    /**
     * Release every lazy island first (`defer-hydration` + `data-gyral-hydrate`), as if each
     * one's trigger had fired. Default `false`: islands keep waiting.
     */
    readonly releaseIslands?: boolean;
}
```


#### `MountedSsr`

```ts
interface MountedSsr {
    /** The element holding the server body (Declarative Shadow DOM already parsed). */
    readonly root: HTMLElement;
    /** Console errors/warnings and uncaught errors seen since mounting (see `hydrated`). */
    readonly problems: readonly string[];
    readonly unmount: () => void;
}
```


#### `MountSsrOptions`

```ts
interface MountSsrOptions {
    /** Restore the page-level store seed (`data-gyral-stores`). Default `true`. */
    readonly stores?: boolean;
    /** Copy `<meta name=…>` elements from the head (e.g. a CSRF token). Default `true`. */
    readonly metas?: boolean;
}
```


#### `Ran`

```ts
interface Ran<S, M> extends Stepped<S, M> {
    /** State after each message, in order. */
    readonly states: readonly S[];
}
```


#### `RunOptions`

```ts
interface RunOptions<S, P> {
    readonly props?: P;
    /** Store instances `ctx.read()` sees. */
    readonly stores?: readonly AnyStoreInstance[];
    /** Start from this state instead of `init(props)` (whose commands are then skipped). */
    readonly state?: S;
}
```


#### `StepMessage`

```ts
type StepMessage<M, P> = M | PropsChanged<P> | IntentRejected | StoreChanged | Hydrated;
```

Any message `update` accepts: the component's own, or a framework message.

#### `Stepped`

```ts
interface Stepped<S, M> {
    readonly state: S;
    readonly commands: ReadonlyArray<Command<M>>;
}
```

A reducer result, normalised: the new state plus the commands it asked for.

#### `VirtualTime`

```ts
interface VirtualTime {
    /** Advances the clock, running due timers and the promise work between them. */
    advance(ms: number): Promise<void>;
    /** Runs every pending timer (and timers they schedule) until none remain. */
    runAll(): Promise<void>;
    /** Current virtual time in ms (`Date.now()` while installed). */
    now(): number;
    restore(): void;
}
```

Controls time in a test. Always `restore()` (for example in `afterEach`).
